{{Top|leg}}
'''Hydraulic pistons''' were used on the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] to open and close the [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] doors. [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88A]], acting as the second Death Star's brain, refused to open a turbolift door for [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] using the hydraulic pistons located within.<ref name="TIA">{{StoryCite|story=Therefore I Am: The Tale of IG-88|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref>

Hydraulic pistons were components utilized by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton's]] [[ASP-7 labor droid/Legends|ASP-7 labor droid]].<ref name="SOTESB">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>
